method: arXiv API export endpoint (https://export.arxiv.org/api/query), 28 query strings, per_page=50, results filtered to records whose title/abstract mention an agent, director, camera, storyboard or interface. Each record is stored with its id, title, published date and first sentence only. No record here was written by hand.
verification: Every id below resolves at https://arxiv.org/abs/<id-without-version>. The first_sentence field is the first sentence of that record's abstract as returned by the API on the harvest date; re-running the harvest may return a later version of the same id.
